subject: english
question:
**Select the option that correctly expresses the following sentence in passive voice.**

The child will recite the poem.

options.text: By child poem will be recited.
The poem will be recited by the child.
The poem is recited by the child.
The poem will recite by the child.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The poem will be recited by the child.**
